name: My Gyaru Girlfriend
source:
With sun-kissed tans, bleached-blonde hair, and an appetite for unruly fun, the girls who identify as gyaru represent the pinnacle of high school fashion, captivating hearts wherever they go, not least of all yours…

So far, the most exciting experiences you’ve had in life are those you’ve encountered between the covers of your manga collection, but sometimes life finds a way of imitating art. When you come to the aid of the hottest gyaru in school, you’re suddenly thrust into the center of dramas involving bullies, anonymous threats, and the attentions of not one but three gorgeous and very different classmates!

Will your newfound day in the sun turn into a summer dream, or a slow-burning catastrophe?
translation:
有着被阳光亲吻过的古铜色、漂白的金发和对不羁乐趣的渴望，这些被认为是“辣妹”的女孩代表了高中时尚的巅峰，无论走到哪里都会吸引人们的心，尤其是你的心……

到目前为止，你生活中最令人兴奋的经历是你在漫画集的封面之间遇到的那些经历，但有时生活会找到一种模仿艺术的方式。当你去帮助学校里最炙手可热的辣妹时，你突然被推入了一系列戏剧的中心，其中涉及欺凌、匿名威胁，以及不是一个而是三个截然不同的华丽同学的关注！

你在阳光下的新一天会变成一场夏日之梦，还是一场缓慢燃烧的灾难？
